name: Refrigerator
scene: A refrigerator standing on the floor, front facing +z, about 5 cm off the wall: cabinet, doors (french door or top freezer), handles, inside shelves and crisper drawers visible when a door opens, the water filter (in the upper right of the fresh-food compartment, the base grille, or behind it), the toe grille at the bottom front, condenser coils behind the toe grille or on the back, and the drain pan under it.
size: 0.75-0.91 m wide, 1.7-1.8 m tall, 0.7-0.8 m deep (doors about 0.07 m thick).

parts.label: Fridge door
parts.describe: Fresh-food door (right one on french door models), hinged at its outer edge, with a handle; inner door bins.

parts.label: Freezer door
parts.describe: Freezer drawer (slides out) or top freezer door (hinged).

parts.label: Water filter
parts.describe: White cartridge in a housing inside the upper right of the fridge (or behind the base grille); twists a quarter turn then pulls out along its axis.

parts.label: Toe grille
parts.describe: Slotted kick plate at the bottom front; pulls off forward.

parts.label: Condenser coils
parts.describe: Black serpentine coil (hose) with fins behind the toe grille or on the back.

parts.label: Dust
parts.describe: Grey lint dust on the coils (patch of lint).

parts.label: Drain pan
parts.describe: Shallow plastic tray under the fridge near the coils; slides out the front.

parts.label: Defrost drain
parts.describe: Hole at the bottom back wall of the freezer or fresh-food section that clogs with ice.

parts.label: Crisper drawer
parts.describe: Clear drawer at the bottom of the fresh-food section; slides out.

parts.label: Temperature control
parts.describe: Dial or touch keys inside the top or on the door display.

parts.label: Power plug
parts.describe: Plug in a wall outlet behind the fridge.

debris: ice or grime blocking the defrost drain
a water puddle on the floor in front
views: low front for the toe grille and coils
inside the fresh-food section at the filter
notes: Hollow cabinet from walls so open doors show the inside; shelves as glass planes or wire grids.
